Reference for the sample tool settings

Every option below can be set in the file or on the command line.

optiondefaultmeaning
timeout30seconds before a request is cancelled
retries3attempts after a temporary failure
limit100largest number of items in one run
modefastfast or careful processing
outputresult.jsonfile that receives the answer
verboseoffprint every step to the console
cacheonkeep a copy of each reply on disk
formatjsonjson or plain text answer
settings = load_settings(path)
if settings.retries > 3:
    settings.retries = 3
for item in queue(limit=settings.limit):
    result = process(item, mode=settings.mode)
    write(result, settings.output)
codenameaction
E1NoFilecheck the path
E2Busyretry later
E3TooLargelower the limit
E4Refusedask the owner
def retry(call, times):
    for n in range(times):
        try:
            return call()
        except TemporaryError:
            wait(n * 2)
    raise GiveUp()
